answer: Physical Presence Beacon. Each identity binds to a distinct handheld device that must broadcast a rolling violet light signature, sampled by nearby agents' cameras and cross-checked against an on-chain crystal hash updated every few minutes. A new identity requires a fresh device plus a verified co-located witness session on a separate island region, so one operator cannot clone signatures without physically acquiring and transporting another device for every identity. Cost per attacker: one device, one witnessed location session, and continuous light upkeep.
